block1.heading: Minor Hotels To Debut in Egypt with Oaks Hotels Resorts & Suites
block1.p1: With creating a unique and distinct character to the project, Creative Kingdom; the largest company specialized in modern and high - end designs that sends out the vibes of serenity mixed with luxury in collaboration with MMAC Designs for the internal designs to achieve the extravagant stay.
block1.p2: In line with our vision to elevate the real estate market, the project took the field by storm and brought things to another level by being one of the first branded residences that is not only introducing a brand-new concept to the sector, but it rather grants you the highest return on the investment.

block2.heading: Joinery and Detail
block2.p1: All joinery was designed in-house and fabricated by a local workshop. The kitchen runs along an entire wall of the open-plan ground floor, finished in a painted sage with unlacquered brass hardware that will patinate over time. A built-in window seat in the reading nook doubles as storage, with cushions upholstered in a durable wool check.
block2.p2: Upstairs, each bedroom was treated as a distinct space rather than a repeated formula. The children's rooms feature built-in beds with integrated shelving, while the primary suite opens through glazed doors onto a private terrace framed by trees.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: As we are committed to prioritize our customer contentment levels, we see our customer as a main pillar in our success journey. We understand the importance of human-centric architecture, design aesthetics, and building a suitable community in which all the amenities come together for the sole reason of reaching impressive levels of customer satisfaction. As such, we aim to establish ourselves as a world-class Real Estate Development Company in the MENA region.

Our projects mobilize an unconditional vision of life across an attractive and evergrowing portfolio of specialized properties. With skyline-defining architecture, an up to date take on interiors and our focus on seamless amenities and services; we are committed to developing destinations that are both authentic and bench-mark standard.

integrity.title: Corporate Integrity
integrity.description: By being transparent and straightforward. We say what we mean, and mean what we say. Margins Developments takes pride in its integrity; promoting balanced constructions and buildings that are optimized towards optimum wellbeing.

opportunities.title: Seizing opportunities

projects.faqDescription: Everything you need to know—explained simply to help you make confident decisions.

faq.question: How do I start buying a property?
faq.answer: Start by defining your budget and requirements, then browse our available units and book a private viewing with our sales team. We'll guide you through reservation, financing options, and paperwork every step of the way.

faq.question: What documents are required?
faq.answer: You'll need a valid national ID or passport, proof of income, and — if you're financing the purchase — recent bank statements. Our sales team will confirm the exact list based on your payment plan.

faq.question: How long does the process take?
faq.answer: Reservation to signed contract typically takes one to two weeks, depending on how quickly financing and documentation are finalized. Delivery timelines vary by project and are shared upfront.

faq.question: Do you offer investment support?
faq.answer: Yes. Our team advises on unit selection, expected rental yield, and resale potential, and can connect you with trusted property management partners after handover.

faq.question: Are there additional costs?
faq.answer: Beyond the unit price, expect a one-time maintenance deposit and standard registration fees. Any club or facility membership costs are disclosed before you sign.
